entities.name: Karl Friedrich Behrens
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Carl Friedrich Behrens was a German sailor and soldier who sailed as a corporal during the expedition led by Jacob Roggeveen to Southern Land, during which Easter Island was discovered, and he was among the first Europeans to set foot there.
